name: Omoi no Kakera
source:
There is a knock on my door. I'm still sleepy, and I pretend I'm not hearing it.

Brother... You're awake, aren't you?
A voice calls out to me. It belongs to a girl. She called me brother... But I don't remember having a sister.

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031759.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
